source_notes.label: Distinct size and batch bases
source_notes.summary: The 40–180 nm Scherrer range, 10–200 nm TEM crystallites and 0.5–5 µm aggregates describe different bases in the nano-Al series. Footnote 6 separately labels a 28 nm analytical input. A 44 nm input appears in a Kelvin-equation argument predicting only a 2–3% equilibrium vapor-pressure increase; it is not a new synthetic specimen. The authors instead propose enhanced nonequilibrium steady-state vapor pressure.
source_locators: Main PDF pp. 1–2, nano-Al characterization, footnote 6 and Kelvin discussion

source_notes.label: Full elemental-analysis context
source_notes.summary: Footnote 6 GDMS preserves all 25 measured impurity elements, with Al by difference, for its hot-pressed specimen. Footnote 9 preserves both exact 1100 °C / 10 h elemental comparisons and theoretical AlN values. These analytical results are not copied to all morphology samples.

source_notes.label: Precursor preparation scope and source warning
source_notes.summary: Footnote 5 reports a powerful explosion during precursor synthesis that deformed the steel fume-hood enclosure. Detailed synthesis/precautions are in unreviewed SI; no precursor preparation protocol is reconstructed here.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1, footnote 5; p. 2, SI notice

source_notes.label: Partial-reaction microscopy
source_notes.summary: Droplet and fiber observations, including 5–15 µm partially reacted Al/AlN droplets and the 10 wt% AlCl3 starfish/shell observations, remain accessible in the source contexts. Unknown collection schedules are not reconstructed as final recipes.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, partial-reaction discussion and footnote 14

source_notes.label: Study-wide AlN diffraction-coherence range
source_notes.summary: The source reports 25–50 nm mean XRD coherence lengths for nano-Al-derived AlN formed at 1000–1100 °C. This precedes the separate morphology discussion and is not assigned as a Figure 1b or 20 °C/min specimen-specific fit. The full statement remains in source contexts, outside product-bound measurements.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1, general nano-Al nitridation/coherence statement

evidence_conflicts.topic: Bulk diffraction versus local incomplete conversion

claims.label: Powder XRD
claims.statement: For 2–3 µm mean Al feed at 1100 °C, both the unmodified and 13 wt% AlCl3 cases show only nano-AlN XRD peaks.

claims.label: TEM / EDX
claims.statement: Both contain spherical aggregates at least 200 nm across built from equiaxed particles at most 20 nm; EDX finds excess Al in these regions.

evidence_conflicts.handling: Preserve technique and sampling basis. No complete conversion or phase-pure product is inferred from the XRD-only statement.

evidence_conflicts.topic: General nano-Al size range and distinct specimen labels

claims.label: General diffraction series
claims.statement: The main preparation series has mean Scherrer dimensions of 40–180 nm.

claims.label: Analytical input and model context
claims.statement: Footnote 6 uses 28 nm nano-Al at 0.5 mol% catalyst, while the Kelvin discussion uses a 44 nm coherence length.
claims.locator: Main PDF p. 1, footnote 6; p. 2, Kelvin discussion

evidence_conflicts.handling: Retain separate contexts and unresolved batch identities; do not repair, average or infer a complete catalyst–size mapping.
